theme_and_archetype.reasoning: For a fashion storefront, we want an editorial 'lookbook' feel. The product imagery provides the color, while the UI remains stark, high-contrast, and minimalist to elevate the premium perception.

typography.strategy: The 'Old Money Tech' variant: Elegant Classic Serif for Headings to communicate luxury and fashion, paired with a Sterile Geometric Mono/Sans for the body/admin to maintain technical clarity.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing for Storefront, Control Room for Admin.

storefront.grid: Bento Grid (Mode A: Tetris Grid) for top collections - massive imagery spanning multiple columns, minimal gaps (gap-4 or gap-1).

admin_panel.grid: Control Room Grid (Mode B) - strict hierarchy, gap-4, high density. pure HTML/Tailwind structures with strict border layouts.

surface_strategies.storefront_header: Crystal Glass: bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-black/5. Must be sticky at top (z-50).
surface_strategies.storefront_cards: Flat, sharp edges (rounded-none). Product cards have no borders, relying entirely on image and text alignment. Image container has overflow-hidden, image scales on hover.
surface_strategies.admin_cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border (border-border), no shadow. Slight shadow-sm on hover.
surface_strategies.buttons: Primary: Sharp edges (rounded-none), pure black (bg-[#0A0A0A] text-white), hover:bg-black/80. Secondary: border border-black/20 text-black hover:border-black.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Product images must scale up (hover:scale-105) with a smooth transition (transition-transform duration-700 ease-out).
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Fade in on scroll for sections.
motion_and_interactions.buttons: Color inversion or fill animation on hover.

components_usage.forms: Use Shadcn Form, Input, Select, Checkbox. Customize inputs to have rounded-none, border-b only (optional) or stark 1px borders.
components_usage.modals_drawers: Use Shadcn Sheet for Cart and Wishlist sidebars. Use Dialog for Quick View.
components_usage.tables: Shadcn Table for Admin panel. Clean, monochrome.
components_usage.icons: lucide-react for standard UI, @phosphor-icons/react (Thin/Light weight) if an editorial feel is needed for storefront.

media.rules: All images MUST use the provided URLs below. Never use generic placeholders.

hero_banner.description: Main hero banner showing street style fashion. Use with a subtle gradient overlay (bg-gradient-to-r from-black/40 to-transparent) to ensure text contrast if text is placed over it.

testing.attributes: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid. Example: data-testid='add-to-cart-button'

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the storefront prioritizing imagery. Product cards should have large images and minimal text below (left-aligned: Title, Price).
Do not use generic border-radii for the storefront. Elements should be sharp (rounded-none) to convey a brutalist high-fashion editorial look.
For the admin panel, use Shadcn with a clean, high-contrast monochrome style.
Implement the Top Collections grid as an asymmetrical Bento layout spanning multiple rows/cols.
Header must be sticky with a glassmorphism effect (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80).
For icons, use lucide-react with stroke-width 1.5 to maintain an elegant, thin look.
Ensure the hero image overlay is not too dark; maximum bg-black/40 if text is on top.
Follow standard e-commerce flows (Cart Sidebar, Checkout Page, Product detail gallery).
Add hover:scale-105 transition-transform on all product listing images to add life.
